name: Marine Adventures Lord Howe
summary: Glass bottom boat tours and private charters in the Lord Howe Island Marine Park, run on the new vessel Adventure Blue. Trips cover turtle spotting, snorkelling and a visit to North Bay, with commentary on the island's marine life. Tours run daily from September to May, and times change each week with the tides.
standouts: Glass bottom boat Adventure Blue, with large viewing panels (the site calls them the largest on the island)
Snorkelling equipment provided on both public tours
Guided seabird walk at North Bay with Anthony
New Expedition Adventure charters beyond the lagoon and reef, for up to 12 people

trips.title: North Bay Turtle & Nature Tour
trips.summary: A three hour trip on the glass bottom boat Adventure Blue to North Bay, with turtle spotting, a wreck snorkel and commentary on the island's marine life. At North Bay guests can climb Mt Eliza, explore the Old Gulch, see the seabird rookery in season and join a guided seabird walk with Anthony. Guests can also swim or simply relax on the beach. Snorkelling equipment is provided.
highlights: Glass bottom boat with large viewing panels
Spot turtles and snorkel the wreck
Time at North Bay: climb Mt Eliza, explore the Old Gulch, guided seabird walk with Anthony

trips.title: Turtle Tour & Two Spot Snorkel Experience
trips.summary: A two hour tour on Adventure Blue centred on the island's turtles and marine life. Guests look through the large glass viewing panels, snorkel off the boat, or do both, and the crew guide them to the best spots in the marine park. Snorkelling equipment is provided.
highlights: Tour dedicated to turtles and marine life
View the reef through large glass panels and/or snorkel off the boat
Crew guide you to the best spots in the marine park
includes: Crew guide to the best spots in the marine park

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private tours on Adventure Blue for family and friends, with room for up to 24 people in the sheltered waters of the lagoon, or 12 on the new Expedition Adventures beyond the lagoon and reef. Charters run for 2 or 3 hours, or can be tailored, and Anthony can build a custom tour or arrange drop offs and pick ups. Options include North Bay, snorkelling, seabird talks and an expedition. Enquiries go direct by email.
highlights: Up to 24 people in the lagoon
Up to 12 people on Expedition Adventures beyond the lagoon and reef
2 hour and 3 hour charters, or a tailored trip
Custom tours, drop offs and pick ups
trips.requirements: Maximum 24 people within the lagoon; maximum 12 on Expedition Adventures beyond the lagoon and reef.
